difficultyTiers.label: Ruined
difficultyTiers.description: The dungeon as it lies. Nothing has been roused yet.

difficultyTiers.label: Haunted
difficultyTiers.description: Something has begun to gather in the halls.

difficultyTiers.label: Cursed
difficultyTiers.description: The dead have put on armour, and they wear it well.

difficultyTiers.label: Mourning
difficultyTiers.description: They come faster now, and the vaults answer in kind.

difficultyTiers.label: Sunken
difficultyTiers.description: No fire will hold here. Rest is a thing you remember.

difficultyTiers.label: Barrow-Cold
difficultyTiers.description: A single warden walks each floor, and the doors have learned to keep.

difficultyTiers.label: Grave-Sworn
difficultyTiers.description: The floors are laid with old malice, and the boss keeps a hoard.

difficultyTiers.label: Rot-Crowned
difficultyTiers.description: Armour and venom together. Even the hearths are starved.

difficultyTiers.label: Ash-Kept
difficultyTiers.description: They do not tire. The doors take two keys and give none back.

difficultyTiers.label: Undying
difficultyTiers.description: Everything at once, in the dark, with no map and no market.
